verdict.rationale: Shopify documents apps that integrate into the admin, online store and checkout, and an Admin API for building apps that extend the admin. A theme storefront offers prebuilt designs, and community posts confirm a third-party app ecosystem billed through merchants' Shopify accounts. The pack never documents a merchant-facing app marketplace, an app review or vetting process, or the breadth of long-tail coverage, so delivery is only inferred. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an app store/marketplace, documented app vetting/review, evidence of long-tail feature coverage by available apps, independent merchant corroboration of installing apps.
